caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a decorative backrest and an upholstered seat. The chair has four tapered legs with vertical grooves, colored in shades of brown to represent wood. The backrest has an ornate design, including a central urn motif and curved elements, all in dark brown. The seat is cushioned and covered in striped fabric of alternating light green and a muted gold or olive tone, with small brass or gold-colored tacks outlining the bottom edge of the seat. The background is plain and off-white, with the chair centered within a faint rectangular border. The artist's signature is present in the lower left corner of the page.
title: Side Chair
